Product Details: Powerful Performance: This HIKOKI mitre saw’s 15 Amp motor delivers a speed of up to 4300 RPM. Precision Cuts: This features Xact Cut LED Shadow Line System, indicating where the blade will cut on the material. Extreme Cut Capacity: This mitre saw with a 12-inch blade can cut up to 7-inch material vertically and 7-1/2-inch nested against the sliding fence. Versatile Miter Range: This compound mitre saw offers a mitre range of 0-52° to both the right and left with detent stops at 0°, 15°, 22.5°, 31.6°, and 45°. Dual-Bevel Capability: Dual bevel range of 0-48° to the left and right with positive stops at 0°, 33.9°, and 45° for high precision cuts. Adjust Cut Angle Options- Has upfront mitre and locks to adjust cut angles to suit the application easily. Lightweight and Extra Base Support: The HIKOKI mitre saw, which weighs only 20 kg, has an additional base for enhanced stability during cutting tasks. Warranty: This compound mitre saw comes with a two-year warranty.
